experiment_config.title: av2_ai_extension_acr_hr_demo
experiment_config.description: PoC of the proposed AV2 AI-extension ACR-HR workflow. Encoded SDR conditions are stand-ins and are not AV2 or AI-extension outputs.

context.title: Instructions
context.text_html:
You will rate the overall picture quality of each video from Bad to Excellent. Some videos may contain plausible-looking changes; penalize altered structure, text, faces, unstable detail, and temporal inconsistency.

Each scored clip plays once. At the rating screen, you may replay that clip up to five times.

Demo note: the encoded conditions in this PoC are stand-ins used to demonstrate the workflow. They are not AV2 or AI-extension outputs.

context.title: Practice example 1 of 2
context.text_html:
This example is for familiarization only. Its score is not recorded. A recommended calibration rating will appear after playback.

How would you rate the overall picture quality?

Recommended rating: 4 – Good.
context.actions_html: Next practice example
